quantity: On dying in the arena the player respawns in the lobby area with their grave, not at their normal respawn point

The client keeps the death coordinate of the grave (varp3916 gravestone_creation_death_coord) and tests it against a zone before reading the waves-completed counter: a grave made in the arena is a distinct case (cache); the wiki agrees (death -> grave in the lobby)
The reclamation (death) fee is reduced by this share while the player has completed fewer than the threshold of waves
The reduction applies until the player has completed this many waves in total; the cache test is `waves_completed < 100`
The threshold before the Part One change was 50 waves, proposed to become 100 (disagreement D27: the later post and the cache are A, the older 50 is history); a builder must not build 50

The counter is varp4131 total_colosseum_waves_completed: it counts completed waves across runs and counts them for a run that later died (wiki: 'this also includes runs where the player completed waves but died')

The zone the grave's death coord is tested against: packed corners 29641745 and 298617908 (decoded by arithmetic: level 0 x1809 z3089 to level 1 x1842 z3124, around region 7216); what the script does inside the zone is not quoted in the dump
The reduced fee is capped at 125,000 coins (wiki only; no Jagex post and no Death's Office source states the cap, D27, M34: the build uses 125000 tagged [M34] until a second source)
After the threshold the standard Death's Office cost applies; outside the reduction the Colosseum uses the standard death/gravestone system

What the grave holds (every item kept/lost under the standard rules, the Dizana's quiver temporary ammo shown in the deathkeep interface 974) and any arena-specific rule: the Death's Office source is not in the corpus
Dying forfeits all accumulated run loot (the pooled rewards), no chest appears
Logging out during a run forfeits all accumulated loot
Teleporting out during a wave forfeits all accumulated loot
Ending the run to claim loot is possible only between waves
Leaving via Minimus restores stats to full but removes boosts
Teleporting or logging out during a wave does not restore stats
Where a player who logged out mid-wave appears on logging back in (the build ends the run and returns to the lobby, tagged [M44], until a source says otherwise)
Whether combat delays the logout in the arena (no source; the build does not borrow the engine default silently)
No source describes a pause option in the Colosseum (the Inferno's pause is not to be built here); logout follows the rows above
Doom kills outright at 15/10/5 stacks by modifier level I/II/III (owned by modifier_system; repeated because death is this unit's: a test reads it from the death path)
Doom stacks reset to 0 at the end of each wave, so a Doom death never carries over
What adds a Doom stack (damage taken, per hitsplat or per hit, 0-hits, scorpion's role) is open in modifier_system; death_and_fee consumes it

Presentation: a player killed by Doom plays a unique death animation, dissolving into a puddle of acid; no sequence id or graphic is named by any source and no rig candidate is bound (the doom scorpion seqs 6252-6262 are the scorpion's, not this)
Presentation: the ordinary player death sequence, the respawn teleport graphic and any sound: no source cited in the corpus gives them; unknown_purpose, no value invented

PLAYER_DEATH (type 6) events in the cached sample: 6 in 18 runs, all in the 6 failed (status 3) runs, 0 in the 12 completed; sampled as 12 completed plus 6 failed late, so the share of runs that die is not estimable
totalDeaths per run: 1 in each failed run and 0 in each completed run: one death ends a run, no revive (observed over 18 runs)
Waves of the six recorded deaths: wave 10 (2 runs) and wave 11 (4 runs); the sample was drawn from late failures, so this is not the arena's death distribution
Tick of the death within its wave stream: 102, 27, 18, 44, 42, 15 (one-tick resolution)

DOOM hitsplats (type 201) in the wave of each death: 5,6,4,5,3,0; Doom (index 8) had been picked by then in 5 of 6; counts 3-6 sit below the I cap of 15, so these are not shown to be Doom kills, and the tier is not read from the sample
